verdict.rationale: The franchise tax page offers a public 'Look Up Account Status' tool. A keyless open-data dataset of active franchise tax permit holders also exposes registration status in machine-readable form. However, status for individual filings or submissions is not shown as publicly viewable: Webfile transactions sit behind an authenticated eSystems session, and the 'reports in processing' notice is only a one-line mention. Missing for 10: documented public lookup of individual filing, application, or case status; detail on what the account status tool returns; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: the Comptroller's Active Franchise Tax Permit Holders dataset answers a keyless Socrata SODA query with structured JSON rows: a real machine-readable rail for registration status
Webfile reports in processing see details
